title: Mutual Information from Modular Flow in General CFTs
summary: The vacuum mutual information (MI) of subregion algebras provides a universal window into the data of general conformal field theories (CFTs). Exploiting the geometric nature of the modular flow associated to ball-shaped regions and the operator product expansion of twist operators implementing the replica symmetry in an $n$-fold version of a CFT, it is possible to construct a hierarchy of increasingly refined approximations to the full MI.
